scope: General Irish property-registration information only; not a property-specific title determination.
core_principles: Property registration records and legal title are related but distinct concepts.
Registered-property questions should begin with the appropriate official record route.
Land Registry records and Registry of Deeds records belong to distinct registration systems.
A folio, title plan or other record can establish facts within its legal and evidential scope but does not automatically resolve every boundary, beneficial-interest, historical or dispute question.
First registration, transfer, mortgage, co-ownership, easement and rectification are separate legal pathways.
Historical property questions require date-aware record and law analysis.
A property-specific conclusion requires authoritative evidence for the identified property.

official_sources.role: Property registration and official property-record services
Official property search and map access

evidence_boundary: No property-specific ownership, boundary, easement, mortgage, beneficial-interest or historical-title conclusion is asserted without verified authoritative evidence.
